sections.heading: Series Overview
paragraphs: Ireland and Afghanistan have embarked on a five-match ODI series, marking a significant event in their cricketing calendars.

sections.heading: Controversy with ECB
paragraphs: According to The Guardian, Ireland's decision to play these matches against Afghanistan has potentially upset the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB).

sections.heading: Match Preview
paragraphs: Cricinfo provides a preview for the 1st ODI match, indicating the start of a new era for both teams as they compete in this series.

sections.heading: Ireland's World Cup Focus
paragraphs: BBC reports on Ireland Cricket's new head coach Gary Wilson, who is intensely focused on World Cup qualification, suggesting the importance of this series for Ireland's cricketing ambitions.
